out.briefing:

texts.text: Fire Dept: EMS en route for a fall injury on floor 6, Northbelt 363 Sam Houston Pky. Please meet EMS at front entrance with freight elevator held in lobby. Where is the AED, if any?

tenant_flags.risk: possible (from name only): vulnerable occupants. Counseling clients, possibly people in emotional distress, may be in the suite.
tenant_flags.why: The name suggests a counseling or mental health practice on the incident floor. Crews may meet clients in distress, so a calm approach and attention to privacy may help. There is no description or industry data to confirm this.

tenant_flags.risk: possible (from name only): higher and changing occupancy. This may be a shared coworking space with many unrelated occupants and visitors.
tenant_flags.why: It is the largest suite on floor 6 at 4,536 sq ft, and the name suggests coworking. That could mean more people in the corridors and in the way of patient access or carry-out. No headcount is given.

tenant_flags.risk: possible (from name only): vulnerable occupants. Mental health clients may be present.
tenant_flags.why: This is one floor above the incident. It matters only if crews stage there, the patient's location is uncertain, or a client is involved. No description is provided.

tenant_flags.risk: possible (from name only): likely an administrative office. Seriously ill patients are probably not on site, but this is not confirmed.
tenant_flags.why: Hospice providers usually care for patients at home, so this suite is probably office staff. It is listed only because it is one floor below the incident and no description confirms what goes on there. No sign of stored medical supplies or hazmat.
